verses.t: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest
verses.pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
verses.yusufAli: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory
verses.rodwell: WHEN the HELP of God and the victory arrive
verses.sale: When the assistance of God shall come, and the victory

verses.t: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes
verses.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops
verses.yusufAli: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds
verses.rodwell: And thou seest men entering the religion of God by troops
verses.sale: and thou shalt see the people enter into the religion of God by troops

verses.t: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance
verses.pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy
verses.yusufAli: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy)
verses.rodwell: Then utter the praise of thy Lord, implore His pardon; for He loveth to turn in mercy
verses.sale: Celebrate the praise of thy Lord, and ask pardon of Him; for He is inclined to forgive
